info.name: Impersonate
info.summary: Provide assistance by logging in as another user
info.description:
The Impersonate application allows administrators, and group admins, to log in as another user within an owncloud.online instance. It provides a helpdesk-like experience and can be useful to help users with configuration issues, to get a better understanding of what they see when they use their owncloud.online account, or to perform actions in legacy accounts.
Once Impersonate is installed, the menu of each user in the user management panel offers "Impersonate". Choose it and you will be logged in as that user. Your current session will be temporarily suspended, and a bar below the header reminds you that you’re impersonating another user. Once you’re finished, choose "Back to my account" or log out, and you will return to your previous user session.
As a security measure, the application lets owncloud.online administrators restrict the ability to impersonate users in specific groups. When enabled and configured, only a group’s administrator can impersonate members of their group. Administrators can find configuration options in the "User Authentication" section of the "Admin settings" panel.
Modified by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online PHP 8.4 compatibility.
